ideal_customer.what_we_sell: An outbound lead generation service for B2B companies that want more sales meetings.
ideal_customer.target_roles: Founders, CEOs, heads of sales, VPs of sales, revenue operations leaders, heads of growth and marketing leaders who own pipeline.
ideal_customer.target_companies: B2B software and services companies with roughly 10 to 500 employees that sell to other businesses.
ideal_customer.not_a_fit: Students, job seekers, recruiters, consumer brands, government, and people at very large enterprises with in-house teams.

personas.founder_or_ceo: Founder, co-founder, owner or chief executive of a company
personas.sales_leader: Runs a sales team: head of sales, VP sales, CRO, sales director
personas.marketing_or_growth_leader: Runs marketing, growth or demand generation
personas.revenue_operations: Revenue operations, sales operations or GTM systems
personas.individual_seller: Account executive, SDR, BDR or other individual sales role
